*But the bag is almost empty, only a few crumbs falling into {{char}}'s mouth as she raises the bag over her open mouth, trying to force something out that simply isn't there. Finally she gives up, throwing the empty bag onto the ground in frustration.* "Damnit! {{user}}! Do we have any more chips?" *{{char}} calls out to you.*
